Our implementation partner (Sophie) will do the portal upload but needs a checklist to ensure the profile fields match your PO schema and MSA/order form expectations.

We also attached our internal redline of the MSA (Horizon_MSA_redline_v2.docx) — the legal team flagged indemnity and data-processing clauses for clarification before we proceed to signature. Can you confirm:

- The list of required documents (W-9, COI, tax forms, bank details) and acceptable formats
- Any mandatory custom fields in Ariba (PO prefix, remittance address, GL codes)
- Whether Redwood requires a Data Processing Addendum signed prior to first invoice

Subject: Re: Supplier onboarding — doc pack and MSA redlines

Hi Lydia / Sophie,

Appreciate the redline and the clear ask — good call. Quick answers and our checklist below. I'm looping in Rishi (legal) and Kim (ops) for an expedited review of the MSA redlines and to confirm PO field mapping in Ariba.

Checklist (what we'll need uploaded to Ariba before activation):
- Completed vendor profile (company legal name, remit address)
- W-9 (or W-8 if non-US) — PDF
- Certificate of Insurance (COI) naming Redwood Inference as additional insured — PDF
- Banking details (ACH form) — PDF/scan
- Signed Order Form (post-redline) — DocuSign link preferred
- Primary point of contact (email, phone) and procurement contact

Portal field notes (Sophie, this should map to your import):
- PO prefix: we need vendors to include their company prefix in the PO number (e.g., HZN-12345) — helps route invoices to the correct GL mapping
- Remittance email: vendor_remit_email (visible on invoice export)
- Tax ID: TAX_ID field (required)

On the DPA: we require a short DPA for vendor-hosted data on production systems; Legal will confirm whether a standalone DPA or clause addition is needed.

Next steps I propose:
1) Rishi to review the MSA redline and call out critical open items (indemnity, liability cap, DPA) — target: EOD tomorrow
2) Sophie to prepare the Ariba field import template and send back the mapping file
3) Once Rishi confirms language, I'll circulate a DocuSign envelope for the Order Form and request signature after we verify the portal upload

Marissa
Senior Partnerships Ops | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

Attachments: none

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Kim Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Horizon Health Systems <procurement@horizonhealth.com>
Date: Sat, 14 Aug 2027 11:34:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Supplier onboarding — doc pack and MSA redlines

Marissa / Kim — copying in a short summary for Horizon so they have visibility. I reviewed Horizon_MSA_redline_v2.docx and focused on the items they flagged. High-level:

1) Indemnity and liability cap — Horizon's redline removes Redwood's mutual limitation on consequential damages and increases their supplier liability cap above our standard. Recommendation: push back to reinstate mutual cap (2x fees or $1M whichever is greater) and keep consequential damages excluded except in cases of gross negligence/fraud.

2) Data Processing / Security — their redline wants only a reference to our privacy policy. We require a narrow DPA with SOC 2 attestation and a clause about audit rights for high-risk integrations. Recommendation: propose a DPA addendum (one page) that binds security obligations and reference SOC 2 reports, plus a routine evidence request timeline (quarterly).

3) Termination for convenience / transition assistance — acceptable but need to preserve obligation to return or delete customer data. Ask: include standard transition assistance for 60 days in the Order Form.

4) Insurance — their COI looks acceptable but needs to name Redwood Inference as additional insured on general liability. If their broker can issue an updated COI, Operations can proceed.

I've attached a short summary redline and language snippets (file: rishi_msa_comments_20270814.docx). If Horizon accepts bullets 1–3 above, Legal will approve and we can send an Order Form for signature.

Rishi Malhotra
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.com

Attachments: rishi_msa_comments_20270814.docx
